HTX's Ethereum hot wallet was compromised on 24 September 2023, resulting in the unauthorized transfer of about 5,000 ETH (valued near $8 million). The attacker returned the funds after receiving a 250 ETH white-hat bounty. The attacker gained access to the private key for HTX's Ethereum hot wallet. All funds could be withdrawn in a single unauthorized transaction. There is no evidence of a protocol or contract vulnerability.
